## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Athens, Greece. It starts at Plateia Thiseos.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Join an Athenian night out with unlimited drinks for an hour, complimentary shots, and free entry to top nightclubs while meeting people from around the world.
>
> Enjoy a lively pub crawl through Athens' best nightlife spots, where you can drink, dance, and socialize with fellow party-goers.
>
> Follow party guides who will lead the way, ensuring you skip the lines and get into the city's premier clubs.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €16.39. It was rated 2.5 out of 5 from 1 ratings. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
